    left_beams = []

    for y in [1.25, 1.75, 2.25]:
        b = sandbox.add_beam(left_x, y, width=beam_w, height=beam_h, angle=0, density=density)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(b, restitution=0.05)

    # Middle band (2.5-5.0): 3 beams
    for y in [3.25, 3.75, 4.25]:

    # Connect left beams vertically
    for i in range(1, len(left_beams)):
        y_anchor = (left_beams[i].position.y + left_beams[i-1].position.y) / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[i], left_beams[i-1], (left_x, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    # Connect middle beam to left middle beam
    left_middle = next(b for b in left_beams if abs(b.position.y - 3.25) < 1e-3)
    y_anchor = (left_middle.position.y + middle_beam.position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(left_middle, middle_beam, (left_x, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    right_middle = right_beams[0]
    y_anchor = (middle_beam.position.y + right_middle.position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(middle_beam, right_middle, (right_x, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    for i in range(1, len(right_beams)):
        y_anchor = (right_beams[i].position.y + right_beams[i-1].position.y) / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(right_beams[i], right_beams[i-1], (right_x, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    if len(right_beams) > 1:

        y_anchor = (left_upper.position.y + right_upper.position.y) / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(left_upper, right_upper, (right_x, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    return left_beams[0]
